name: 19. Jahrestagung der dggö 2027
organizer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Gesundheitsökonomie (dggö); local organisation Prof. Dr. Lars Schwettmann
venue: Carl von Ossietzky Universität Oldenburg, Campus Haarentor (buildings A1 and A14), Uhlhornsweg 86, 26129 Oldenburg
conf_dates_note: Theme 'Grenzen überwinden'. Pre-conference workshop for early-career researchers on 15 March 2027, 12:00-18:00.
deadline_note: Abstract submission open from 1 October to 16 November 2026.
submission_requirements: Abstract via the conference manager system. Conference website is in German.
registration_fee: Early (4-15 Jan 2027) / late (16 Jan-1 Mar 2027) / on-site: members EUR 185/230/290; non-members EUR 375/460/575; student members EUR 95/130/175; student non-members EUR 185/230/270. Pre-conference workshop EUR 20.
